newsitem.title: USA: The top 10 movies at the U.S. box office.
newsitem.headline: The top 10 movies at the U.S. box office.

text.p: Following are the top 10 movies at the U.S. box office during the Friday to Sunday weekend, according to studio estimates released by Exhibitor Relations Co. Final data will be released on Monday.
(Last weekend's position in parenthesis, * = new release).

NOTE: First Wives Club is released by Paramount Pictures, a unit of Viacom Inc. "Last Man Standing" is released by New Line Cinema, a unit of Turner Broadcasting System Inc. "Fly Away Home" and "Maximum Risk" are released by Columbia Pictures, a unit of Sony Corp. "Bulletproof" is released by Universal Pictures, a unit of Seagram Co. Ltd. "First Kid" is released by Walt Disney Co.. "Tin Cup" and "A Time To Kill" are released by Time Warner Inc.'s Warner Bros. "Independence Day" is released by News Corp.'s 20th Century Fox.
